name: tradrl-adapters-nautilus
description: NautilusTrader historical-data adapter (W021): maps NautilusTrader-style historical dtype records (Bar, TradeTick, QuoteTick — ns timestamps, documented dtype field names, instrument_id conventions) into W020-importable HistoricalRecord sets + dataset descriptors with honest fidelity declarations (what is preserved, what is approximate — never claimed beyond the data). Fixture-based — NO parquet/nautilus_trader dependency (a TL action item per spec/THIRD-PARTY-TECHNOLOGY-REGISTER.md); deterministic pure transforms only (A9).
